validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: extensively and independently documented as a real, large GAIL trunk project (PNGRB authorisation BID/NGPL/14/2019/01/MNJPL, authorised 15.05.2020), not a GEM-only entity -- constructionworld.in (2023-07-20 press conference coverage), Indian Infrastructure (2025-11-07, 84% physical progress as of Sept-2025), and CGDIndia (2026-03-27, sections already commissioned) each independently describe an active, ongoing/near-complete build across Maharashtra-Madhya Pradesh-Chhattisgarh-Odisha. CLASSIFICATION: Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct -- this is PNGRB's own NGPL common-carrier authorisation (Sr. No. 22 of the May-2026 register), and every independent source describes a cross-state transmission trunk (with a Nagpur-Jabalpur branch), not a gathering/process line. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 27-row India-gas roster for this batch -- no other row names Mumbai, Nagpur, Jharsuguda or Jabalpur, or describes an obviously-overlapping route; no double-count found. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=GAIL (India) Ltd 100% is corroborated by the PNGRB register (entity=GAIL) and CGDIndia's naming of 'GAIL (India) Limited' as the project sponsor -- no source names a co-owner. StartLocation=Mumbai/Maharashtra and EndLocation=Jharsuguda/Odisha match every source's description of the route's endpoints (the line also transits Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, which is normal -- Start/End columns record endpoints, not transit states). SPEC: LengthKnown=1,755.00 km equals PNGRB's May-2026 register 'authorised length' for this exact authorisation, and constructionworld.in (2023, independent of PNGRB) separately states the same '1,755 km' total -- two independent sources agree, high tier. Capacity=16.50 MMSCMD equals the register's authorised/determined capacity, and Indian Infrastructure (2025-11-07, independent of PNGRB) separately states 'a design capacity of 16.5 million standard cubic metres per day' -- two independent sources agree, high tier. StartYear1=2025 is directionally consistent with the evidence (multiple 2025-published sources gave a Dec-2025 commissioning target for the first sections, and CGDIndia confirms by 2026-03 that the Mumbai-Nagpur, Nagpur-Jharsuguda(CG&OD) and Nagpur-Jabalpur sections had in fact been commissioned) but no source pins an exact first-gas month -- treating this as an open precision question for Update rather than a hard error, since it is not contradicted by anything found.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Went to the regulator's register first per the country guidance. The May-2026 PNGRB NGPL MIS report -- the freshest edition available -- classifies this exact authorisation (Sr. No. 22, GAIL, authorised 15.05.2020, 1,755 km / 16.5 MMSCMD) under 'OPERATIONAL COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE', its top section, NOT under 'PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED' (the bucket a genuinely-still-building line like the batch's own P0929/JHBDPL sits in with an explicit under-construction-km figure). This row carries no separate under-construction/lowered/welded/hydrotested figures at all -- 1,707 of the 1,755 authorised km are recorded as operating (97.3%), and PNGRB records actual natural gas being supplied on the line (0.47 MMSCMD, albeit only 3% of authorised capacity, consistent with an early-ramp-up flow rate rather than a still-unbuilt line). Since PNGRB is the value's own origin, I traced independent, dated trade press for corroboration that commissioning genuinely happened rather than the register mis-classifying it: Indian Infrastructure (2025-11-07, reporting Sept-2025 progress) already had the project at 84% physical progress with ~1,440 km 'ready for gas-in' and Part B (Nagpur-Jharsuguda) fully ready across 489 km, targeting completion by 2025-12-31. CGDIndia (2026-03-27, independent of both PNGRB and Indian Infrastructure) reports as current fact -- not as a target -- that the 'Mumbai-Nagpur, Nagpur-Jharsuguda (Chhattisgarh & Odisha Section) and Nagpur-Jabalpur sections of the pipeline have been commissioned', with only the remaining full-system completion date pushed from 2026-03-01 to 2026-06-30 (itself now past as of this review, 2026-08-10, with no further slippage news found). Two genuinely independent, dated 2025-2026 sources plus the regulator's own current-edition operational classification all point the same direction: this line is substantially built and carrying gas, not merely 'under construction'. Recommend Status='operating'. Precision caveat: exact first-gas month is not pinned by any source found (earliest hard evidence of actual commissioning is the 2026-03-27 CGDIndia report; the register's own gas-supply/utilisation figures are dated 'MAY 2026'); StartYear1=2025 already on the sheet is plausible given the Dec-2025 target but not independently confirmed to the month -- flagging as an open precision question for Update, not contradicting it. This is the mirror case of the batch's Mallavaram-Bhopal-Bhilwara-Vijaipur pair (P0938/P3602): PNGRB tracks partially-built lines separately, and this line's placement in the OPERATIONAL section (unlike JHBDPL/P0929's PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED placement, which stayed 'construction' on this same pass) is exactly the signal the country guidance says to trust.
